youtube.title: Woh Jellyfish Jo Kabhi Marti Hi Nahi, Kaise? 🪼 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ek jellyfish aisi hai jo waqt ko piche mod sakti hai. Size mein aapke nakhun se bhi chhoti, aur rehti hai samundar mein.

Jab yeh zakhmi hoti hai, bhookhi hoti hai ya boodhi, tab bhi marti nahi. Yeh pighalkar ek goley jaisi ban jaati hai aur phir se bachcha ban jaati hai. Phir apni poori zindagi dobara shuru karti hai, baar baar. Ise koi kha sakta hai, par budhape se yeh bach nikalti hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
